content.short: NFT bases game based around three fundamental aspects, making the game ‘unique’ in the CNFT space.
content.description:
ADAZOO’s goal is to be one of the first NFT based games running on the Cardano blockchain. The game will revolve around three fundamental aspects, making the game ‘unique’ in these early days of the CNFT space.

COLLECTIBLES: Just like every other NFT, you will own an unique asset with common, less common or rare attributes. The NFT’s of ADAZOO are called LACIE tokens. You will be able to collect and/or trade these LACIE’s.

‍ GAMIFICATION: By owning a LACIE token, the user will be eligible to participate in the game. In the game a user will be able to obtain more LACIE’s and gain XP to level your character, making him stronger.

‍ VIRTUAL LAND: Besides LACIE tokens, users will be able to purchase LAND tokens. These tokens will enable the owner to monetize on top of every transaction made within its borders, meaning every capture of a wild LACIE.
